trap.label: would × used to
trap.wrong: They would live in Recife and would be happy.
trap.right: They used to live in Recife and used to be happy.
trap.why: Em português “moravam” e “encontravam-se” são ambos imperfeito. Em inglês, would só para ação repetida; estado (live, be, have) exige used to.

fix.right: I used to have a bike.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com would: “They used to meet every Sunday.”
Reescreva com used to (estado): “She was shy.” (antigamente)
